notes.title: Madnight 2025 Has Ended – Now the Hellish wait begins!

But that's not all. During Madnight 2025, we answered your questions about Sirens, Lust of God, Agony: Lords of Hell and we revealed many details about these productions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25386726/0936d867be95b03d0ed6aec5c258f768ff28f8ff.jpg

Now, Tormentor is officially on Kickstarter. If you want this game to be as brutal, raw, and uncompromising as we envision, we need your support.

👉 Follow and Back Tormentor, now on Kickstarter:

The masterminds behind Tormentor joined us for exclusive interviews, revealing details and their vision for the many aspects of gameplay in Tormentor.

⚡ The Biggest Premiere in Our History

notes.title: Free code for Paranoid owners
notes.content:
Hi,  

We are pleased to announce that our new game - Nymphomaniac: Sex Addict, which will premiere in early access on August 27, 2024, will be available for free for Paranoid owners!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33887493/3ac7cba6578fb0354a5bd6818dbbff00b34fb975.jpg

To get your Nymphomaniac key, you must meet the following requirements:

1. Buy Paranoid before the release of Nymphomaniac: Sex Addict.
2. Go to your Steam profile page in a web browser. 
3. Copy the link to your profile.
4. Make sure your game library is public (on August 26-28) so we can verify ownership of the game.
5. Make sure that your profile on August 26-28 contains the email address from which you are sending the message. For example: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33887493/ab04485a8df75886ea65a35a79cf79064f37e273.jpg

6. Send an email directly to Vydija: vydija.mmnd@gmail.com
In the content of the email:

- Enter "To My Beloved Vydija" in the email subject
- insert a link to your Steam profile
- type "I own the Paranoid game and would like to receive a free Steam code for Nymphomaniac: Sex Addict."
- type "I consent to the processing of e-mail addresses by Madmind Studio S.A. for the duration of the promotion."

7. Done!
Vydija will respond to your message on the day of Nymphomaniac's release, sending you a code for the game. 

Of course, you can also add something from yourself in your message. Our Vydija likes to read love letters. 

Nymphomaniac: Sex Addict is a game intended for adult audiences only, which means it cannot be automatically added to your Steam accounts. You must be willing to do so. You will do this by following the steps described above. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3002570/Nymphomaniac__Sex_Addict/


We invite you to the premiere on August 27, 2024! 

/Madmind

notes.title: New patch for Paranoid is ready

-Resolved an issue where the text "finisher_8" would appear after performing a finisher on enemies.
-Fixed a bug where enemies were holding the hammer incorrectly.
-Addressed an inconsistency where the baseball bat appeared differently on the ground and in Patrick's hands.

notes.title: The patch 1.1 for Paranoid is ready
notes.content:

The patch 1.1 for Paranoid is live and ready for download.
We managed to fix many technical errors that you reported in recent days.

The following are all the fixes implemented right now:

Major


-Fixed condition to trigger alternative ending. Now players will get a choice right after leaving an apartment

notes.title: Paranoid Patch 1.1 is Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We are enormously grateful for the amount of feedback and suggestions we get from you about Paranoid.

Unfortunately, the game's premiere turned out to be disappointing both for you and for us.

We sincerely apologize for the technical issues the game is currently facing.

In the coming days, we will strive to address the majority of errors reported by you and correct them with subsequent updates. We are committed to ensuring that you can enjoy the game in the form we intended to present it to you.

Thank you for your support, and... we're back to working on the fixes!

/ Madmind

notes.title: MADNIGHT 2021: Horror Showcase
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We would like to invite you to the video presentation organized together with Rely On Horror - "MADNIGHT 2021: Horror Showcase", during which new materials from the widely understood horror games produced by Madmind Studio will be presented, with guest participation of developers from other studios.

MADNIGHT 2021: The Horror Showcase takes place December 16, 2021.

The entire event will be available at www.relyonhorror.com - one of the largest, most popular websites focused on horror games.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34139853/d92e8046f12eb649c01404242936cde9a3529667.jpg

MADNIGHT 2021 is an event unprecedented in the gaming industry, during which players will be able to get to meet the Hell Messenger for the first time - a mysterious creature with which they have been interacting for many months on our social media and Madmind Studio's Discord channel.

The Hell Messenger will take viewers into a terrifying world of horror that can take many forms. Have you ever wondered what working in a crematorium looks like? What does a person with advanced paranoid schizophrenia feel and see? Or maybe you want an extreme dose of uncompromising brutality and gore? You will see all these and many other attractions soon during MADNIGHT 2021!

MADNIGHT 2021 Horror Showcase will feature:

- Madmind Studio
- Black Rat
- Live Motion Games
- Lunarium Creations
- IGNIBIT
- Woodland Games

Over the past five years, Madmind Studio has become synonymous with frightening, controversial and violent games. This year's premiere of the studio's latest game, Succubus, was very well received by players and critics who decided to give the game very positive recommendations.

In addition to good grades, Succubus achieved great financial results. Released on October 5 2021, the game has so far made more money on Steam than the studio's previous game, Agony, in more than three years since its release.

“Succubus, announced back in 2018, after almost three full years of production, has finally been released. We wanted the game to be able to defend itself with the quality of workmanship and an original, previously unheard of in video games, dose of uncensored brutality on the day of its premiere. We are looking forward to the premiere of the first Succubus DLC, which will be released during MADNIGHT 2021 ” - Madmind Studio.

See you soon!
 
www.relyonhorror.com
www.madmind-studio.com

notes.title: Torture your victims in style to become a star of Tormentor!
notes.content:
Hell(o) Martyrs,

I invite you to discover the trailer of the new game by the creator of Agony and Succubus:

[previewyoutube=4iqNh7AmtCg;full][/previewyoutube]

Tormentor will be a horror game, which allows players to perform a torturer's role. By managing a prison that has been vacant for years, the main character fights against a growing mental illness. To get more doses of the experimental drug, players will have to show creativity in torturing their victims to gather as many spectators as possible during live-streams on the dark web.

Designed for Next Generation

From the beginning, the game is designed for the next generation of devices. Using technologies such as raytracing unusually, Tormentor will allow players to look at the world of the game and the possibilities it offers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33887493/3171552d333d78f35cf7752d6cf552d9d3187fa2.jpg

Create your victims

The Tormentor will allow players to create the perfect victims for their prisons using an extensive character editor. Players will not only be able to create the perfect victim. They will also build their character card, choose the tone of voice and behavioral patterns.

Main Features

 Expansion of the prison with new instruments of torture
 Extensive character editor for creating new victims
 Video transmission equipment
 Organizing a hunt for yourself
 Brutal executions
 Fighting and sneaking in TPP mode
 Receiving donations and new victims from sponsors


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33887493/8fc7112a3c390f2f29ec2a63ed2e83b0bffb2303.jpg

notes.title: SUCCUBUS - spin-off to Agony - with first gameplay!
notes.content:
Hell(o) Martyrs,

Madmind Studio presents the Official Succubus Gameplay Reveal.

Succubus is a spin-off to Agony, and tells the story of a succubus named Vydija.

The following material has been recorded during the demo showcase at Poznań Game Arena 2019, but the version you are about to see is completely uncensored.

[previewyoutube=pae3JCyFgLs;full][/previewyoutube]

You are the Succubus – a wild and lustful demon who rejected the role of the queen of the infernal abyss. ­With the disappearance of the legitimate rulers of Hell, the remaining demons recognized Nimrod as their ruler, because he was the only soul who could dominate the mind of the mighty Beast. By raising his new empire from the corpses of sinners, the new king, along with his new queen – you – managed to control the chaos left by former rulers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33887493/936f484521f68c8cb4d47c85b1dba0c512aa9f95.jpg

The life of luxury and walking on rugs sewn from the skins of martyrs was not for you though, and so you have chosen a life in the wilderness. By satisfying your appetites and original instincts, you inflict pain by hurting everyone and everything on your path. The moment you meet the powerful Baphomet who, together with his army, is going to get the soul of Nimrod, you are captured and maimed.

Betrayed by your own species you are left with only one goal that matters – revenge!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33887493/a57614e1b72a29a374b2e03f956f89da0cadbca5.jpg

KEY FEATURES:


 Intense and brutal action using weapons and pyrokinesis.
 Diversified opponents.
 Expandable skill tree.
 A system of weapons and armor that affect player's statistics.
 Character and Hub customization.
 A rich and diverse world of Hell.
 A multi-story plot combining horror with action and survival.
 Hostile environment full of traps and enemies.
 Surreal visual setting and gore.
 Boss fights.


Best wishes,
Madmind Studio Team

notes.title: PARANOID gets a new trailer!
notes.content:
Madmind Studio is thrilled to present you a new trailer for PARANOID – a first-person survival horror which takes place in the late ‘80s and combines a deep psychological plot with dynamic and brutal action. 

PARANOID is developed by an internal Madmind Studio team created especially for this project. The game is going to be released exclusively on Steam.

The trailer which you are about to watch focuses on presenting the paranoia of the main protagonist - Patrick - showing his struggle with the progressive mental illness. The subject of mental illness is very serious and we want to address it with proper respect.

https://youtu.be/LSIEGh5_caQ
PARANOID tells the story of Patrick Calman, a 31-year-old man who lost his whole family in mysterious circumstances – his parents died in a brutal accident and his sister suddenly went missing. Trauma associated with the loss of his loved ones destroyed Patrick's psyche and made him a prisoner of his own apartment.
 
One day Patrick answers the phone and the voice in the receiver seems to belong to his sister who went missing 13 years ago. She announces her arrival – so many years after disappearing. This forces Patrick to walk away from his safe but unhealthy life in isolation, exposing himself to horrible experiences on the verge of madness.

Paranoid – Key Features:

●    A deep, immersive plot combining psychological horror with survival and combat.
●    A disturbing atmosphere that mixes psychosis with surrealism.
●    Realistic graphics.
●    Dreadful enemies.
●    Realistic and brutal melee combat.
●    Gameplay balancing on the verge of paranoia and reality.
●    Gameplay based on taking various types of drugs.
●    Three different endings depending on the style of the player's gameplay.

We can't wait to find out what you think about our new project.

All the best,
Madmind Studio Team
